bricks.label: struct Stack
bricks.plain_english: Defines the stack — an array of MAX elements and a top index. The container.
bricks.scene_description: An empty vertical column of boxes appears.

bricks.label: init()
bricks.plain_english: Sets top to -1. An empty stack has top = -1 by convention.

bricks.label: push()
bricks.plain_english: Checks for overflow. If safe, increments top and places the value at arr[top].
code_snippet: void push(struct Stack* s, int val) {
bricks.scene_description: New box slides in from above. TOP arrow moves up.

bricks.label: pop()
bricks.plain_english: Checks for underflow. If safe, returns arr[top] and decrements top.
bricks.scene_description: Top box slides out. TOP arrow moves down.

bricks.label: peek()
bricks.plain_english: Returns arr[top] without removing it. Just looks at the top element.
bricks.scene_description: Top box pulses and highlights without moving.

bricks.label: isEmpty()
bricks.scene_description: TOP label glows when the stack is empty.

bricks.label: isFull()
bricks.scene_description: Overflow warning indicator appears at the top of the column.

bricks.label: display()
bricks.plain_english: Loops from top to 0, printing each element. Shows the full stack contents.
bricks.scene_description: Each box pulses from top to bottom in sequence.
